name: Vol-regime rotation: high-vol RSI reversion on alt majors
rationale: THESIS: high-beta alts overshoot harder than BTC/ETH in high-vol regimes — thinner books and reflexive liquidation cascades stretch them further from fair value, so the high-vol oversold snap-back is mechanically larger on alts. We run the high-vol-armed reversion (vol_realized>floor BOUNDED + RSI<oversold floor BOUNDED) and let the cross-sectional universe select the alt majors (SOL/XRP/ADA/AVAX/LINK/BNB) via min_instruments. DISCONFIRMER: run the IDENTICAL rule restricted to BTC/ETH (the lowest-beta majors). If the low-beta majors do not materially underperform the broader alt set on deflated-Sharpe net of fees, the alt-overshoot premise is false and this is just generic high-vol reversion that happens to include alts — the asset tilt earns nothing. Also: drop the vol gate to confirm it is not plain oversold-buying.
catalyst: Realized vol is elevated and an alt major prints oversold RSI — a stretched high-beta overshoot primed to snap back.
